# Prefect

> > Prefect is a Python-based workflow orchestration platform offering Prefect Cloud for data pipelines, Prefect Horizon for AI agent automation, and FastMCP for Model Context Protocol server management.

Prefect provides enterprise-grade workflow orchestration with solutions spanning data engineering (dbt, Databricks), MLOps (XGBoost, Dask), AI agents (Pydantic AI), and application engineering. The platform includes Prefect Cloud with SOC 2 compliance and RBAC, Prefect Horizon for MCP server hosting, and FastMCP for building AI-powered workflows.

## Key Topics

- Workflow Orchestration
- Python Automation
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- FastMCP
- Prefect Cloud
- Prefect Horizon
- AI Agents & Pydantic AI
- Data Engineering & ETL Pipelines
- MLOps & Machine Learning
- dbt Integration
- GitHub & Git Version Control
- RBAC & Security Compliance
- Background Tasks & Task Queues
- CI/CD for Data Platforms
- Enterprise Platform Features

## Core Platform & Products

- [Prefect - Workflow Orchestration & AI Infrastructure](https://www.prefect.io): Homepage for Prefect Cloud, Horizon & FastMCP workflow orchestration
- [Prefect Cloud - Enterprise Orchestration Platform](https://www.prefect.io/prefect/cloud): Enterprise platform with SOC 2, RBAC, hybrid execution & event automation
- [Pricing - Prefect Cloud](https://www.prefect.io/pricing): Seat-based pricing tiers with SSO, SAML & serverless credits comparison
- [Introducing Prefect Horizon](https://www.prefect.io/blog/prefect-horizon): AI automation platform with FastMCP & Model Context Protocol hosting
- [Horizon Registry - MCP Server Catalog](https://www.prefect.io/horizon/registry): Central catalog for MCP server capabilities, versions & ownership tracking
- [Horizon Deploy - Managed MCP Server Hosting](https://www.prefect.io/horizon/deploy): Managed MCP server hosting with CI/CD, OAuth & GitHub integration

## Solutions by Use Case

- [AI Teams | Prefect](https://www.prefect.io/solutions/agents): AI agent orchestration with Pydantic AI, state machines & dynamic workflows
- [Machine Learning Teams | Prefect](https://www.prefect.io/solutions/machine-learning-teams): ML orchestration solution with XGBoost, Dask & Python for production MLOps
- [Data Engineering | Prefect](https://www.prefect.io/solutions/data-engineering): ETL pipelines with dbt, Databricks integration for Washington Nationals
- [Application Engineering | Prefect](https://www.prefect.io/solutions/application-engineering): Python task queue for async processing with Pydantic, Kafka & microservices

## AI Agents & FastMCP

- [Build AI Agents That Resume from Failure with Pydantic AI](https://www.prefect.io/blog/prefect-pydantic-integration): PrefectAgent integration enables durable execution & failure recovery for LLMs
- [Moving Claude Skills Server-Side with Remix Servers](https://www.prefect.io/blog/moving-claude-skills-server-side-with-remix-servers): Remix servers enable portable MCP workflows across Claude, Cursor & ChatGPT
- [Building a Knowledge Work Stack with FastMCP](https://www.prefect.io/blog/building-a-knowledge-work-stack-with-fastmcp-instead-of-microsoft-office): Replace Microsoft Office with FastMCP, DuckDB & git for version-controlled work

## Technical Guides & Best Practices

- [Beyond Loops: Scaling to Thousands of Parallel Tasks](https://www.prefect.io/blog/beyond-loops-how-prefect-s-task-mapping-scales-to-thousands-of-parallel-tasks): Task mapping architecture for parallel processing vs Airflow DAG patterns
- [Building Better Data Platforms with CI/CD](https://www.prefect.io/blog/building-better-data-platforms-with-ci-cd): CI/CD practices for data pipelines: automated testing & deployment strategies
- [How to Roll Back Deployments in Prefect with Deployment Versioning](https://www.prefect.io/blog/how-to-roll-back-deployments-in-prefect-with-deployment-versioning): Deployment versioning for Git & Docker rollbacks without CI/CD reruns
